purpose: Evaluate Tessellum's digestion pipeline (plan -> augment -> review -> execute) against real golden triples produced by the SAME four skills, run at scale in a production vault.

framing.why_this_is_a_valid_golden: The reference plans and notes were produced by the identical four digestion skills that Tessellum's composer runs as tessellum.composer.digestion.run_digestion_pipeline (PHASE_SKILLS = plan_digestion, augment_digestion_plan, review_digestion_plan, execute_digestion_plan). So this is a same-pipeline reproduction test: feed Tessellum the same raw docs, and its generated plan + notes should match the golden's measurable structure (schema, BB atomicity, section coverage, cross-reference floors, density caps, gate outcomes).
framing.what_it_is_not: Not a byte-for-byte match test. Digestion is generative; the golden fixes the STRUCTURE and MEASURABLE CONTRACTS (counts, distributions, schema conformance, coverage, floors), and an LLM-judge rubric scores content fidelity against the source. Prose will differ run-to-run.

full_corpora.note: The complete triples live in a private knowledge vault (git 59bdae36c). Only the three curated, scrubbed SLICES + measured golden facts are vendored into this public repo. To reproduce against the full corpora, point a runner at the vault paths below.

curated_slices.difficulty: mix of concept + procedure; one very large source page (mcp.md, 6822 words, 41 code blocks) that MUST split into 8 notes
tests: aggressive split of an oversized code-heavy page
concept-vs-procedure BB routing within one topic

curated_slices.source: Hermes Agent docs — Getting Started & Install (sub-plan SP01)
curated_slices.difficulty: procedure-heavy with one navigation (router) note and one model (container architecture) note; the FOUR-FLOOR cross-ref (>=8 term, >=5 repo, >=10 snippet, >=10 doc)
tests: BB routing to navigation + model, not just procedure
highest cross-ref floor of the three
install-variant note fan-out (termux / nix / nixos-module / container)

curated_slices.source: OpenClaw docs — Concepts / agent runtime core (sub-plan co01)
curated_slices.difficulty: concept + procedure + model mix; a 9-gate plan (adds G9 prose-integrity); notes carry BOTH ## Related Notes and a ## References (external-URL) section
tests: dual cross-ref blocks (Related Notes internal + References external)
one-page-to-two-notes split (active-memory -> overview concept + config procedure)

scoring.content_fidelity: LLM-judge 6-dim rubric (relevance, completeness, accuracy, clarity, structural_integrity, epistemic_congruence) — reuses tessellum.composer.eval.LLMJudge against the named source page(s).
